integrity: Full source model and threshold reconstructed from publisher-hosted article; Mittag-Leffler scalar kernel positivity, finite mass and nonintegrable power-law tail yield direct multi-order comparison and force-transfer proof. Exact rational algebra independently replayed. No infinite claim is inferred from numerical simulations.
scientific_limitations: Strictly subcritical reproduction number, with all six Caputo orders in (0,1) and at least one initially infected-pathway compartment seeded.
The treated-burden divergence requires kappa>0; the unseeded infection-free subspace and R0=1 are excluded.
The all-time integrals are literal mathematical integrals of normalized-time state variables, not validated physical infection counts.
Classical-order finite-burden contrast concerns the case where all six orders equal one, not arbitrary mixed boundary orders.
title: Subcritical clearance coexists with divergent lifetime burden in a multi-order SEIATR model
